description:
PROBLEM: importing _project.scripts.explorer_pipeline.contract (which itself has no imports) costs about 4 s because the package __init__ eagerly imports duckdb_builder -> models -> benchbox.core.cost -> the whole benchbox package plus pandas. Every script process in the explorer pipeline and its tests pays this.

CHANGE: make the package __init__ lazy (PEP 562 __getattr__ re-exports, or no re-exports with callers importing submodules directly), keeping every currently imported public name importable from the package.

DECISION GATES:
G1 Find every importer of names from the package (grep and the explorer workflows); each must still work. Run the explorer-related unit tests and the deploy-workflow test.
G2 Measure python -X importtime for contract import before/after (local) and the explorer test times on CI.
G3 If laziness breaks a documented public import surface that cannot be preserved, stop and record (C10).
